description: Get the verified profile and contact options of Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어), a home interior and remodeling contractor in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul serving Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon. Use it when the user looks for or compares an interior contractor in the Seoul metropolitan area, or asks for human consultation or a callback. Photo-design entry and selected room/style choices are handled by get_interior_styles. Returns the business summary, rating, case page link, address, telephone and links only. It does not place a call, store contact details, submit a lead or confirm an appointment.
